explanation: vfs_file_free(file) is called when the path lookup fails, but execution continues. file->flags, file->offset, and file->ref are then written on freed memory. Opening a non-existent path triggers this UAF in the VFS layer.

fs_block_free(blk) is called when the block number is out of range, but execution continues. disk_read then writes into blk->data on freed memory. Requesting an out-of-range block number triggers this UAF.

inode_free(ino) is called when the filename is too long, but execution continues. strncpy and subsequent field writes access freed inode memory. Creating a file with an excessively long name triggers this UAF.

dir_entry_free(ent) is called when the directory is empty, but the for loop still executes. memcpy writes into freed ent memory when a match is found. Looking up a file in an empty directory triggers this UAF.
pipe_buf_free(pbuf) is called when there are no readers, but execution continues. memcpy writes into pbuf->data on freed memory. Writing to a pipe with no readers triggers this UAF.

vm_area_free(vma) is called when the mapping length is invalid, but execution continues. vma->start, vma->end, vma->prot, and vma->flags are then written on freed memory. Calling mmap with zero or oversized length triggers this UAF.
dentry_free(de) is called when the dentry cache is full, but execution continues. strncpy and subsequent field writes access freed dentry memory. Inserting into a full dentry cache triggers this UAF.

tmpfs_node_free(node) is called for an unknown node type, but execution continues. node->type, node->size, node->mtime, and node->name are then written on freed memory. Creating a tmpfs node with an invalid type triggers this UAF.

ext4_inode_free(ino) is called when the inode number is out of range, but execution continues. block_read then writes into freed inode memory. Requesting an invalid inode number on an ext4 filesystem triggers this UAF.

journal_block_free(jb) is called when the transaction is not in COMPLETE state, but execution continues. jb->seq, jb->type, and jb->csum are then written on freed memory. Committing an incomplete transaction triggers this UAF in the journaling layer.
